top_risk_drivers: Live, unredacted student PII (first/last name, father's name, two mobile numbers, date of birth) is stored in studentDB.accdb, committed to a public source repository, behind an application with zero authentication, authorization, or encryption anywhere in the 461 hand-written lines.

Confirmed, exploitable SQL-injection vector: ViewForm.vb:50 concatenates raw txtSearch.Text into both an equality clause and a LIKE clause with no parameterization, giving any user of the running app a live path to the entire PII dataset.

Zero automated test coverage and no CI/CD pipeline anywhere in the repository — there is no regression safety net for any change, and no executable specification of current behavior exists to migrate against.

Hardcoded, author-machine-only absolute database path (Module1.vb:7, 'D:\PROGRAMING\...') with no App.config/Settings indirection — a clean clone of this repository cannot connect to its own bundled database without a source change.

No data-access layer: all 16 SQL statements live inline in UI event handlers across 4 of 6 modules, joined only by one shared, globally mutable, never-disposed OleDbConnection (Module1.dbcon) that one module (ViewForm) unilaterally closes — the tightest and riskiest coupling point in the application.

highest_risk_modules.reason: 13-line 'data access layer' that is really just a shared, undisposed, globally mutable connection object with a hardcoded unreachable path; every other module's correctness depends on this module's lifecycle discipline, which does not exist.

Contains the application's only confirmed SQL-injection vector (ViewForm.vb:50), unilaterally closes the shared global connection (ViewForm.vb:94), and triplicates its own data-loading logic across three methods.

1,211-line Designer file / 77 controls acting simultaneously as navigation shell, child-form host, and statistics engine; owns 2 of the application's 3 circular module-dependency cycles and a silent data-correctness defect (hardcoded currentYear = 2023).

regulatory_surface_flags: PII at rest with no encryption or access control: studentDB.accdb stores first/last name, father's name, two mobile numbers, and date of birth for what the project materials describe as minor students.
No authentication or authorization layer protects any create/read/update/delete operation against the PII-bearing 'students' table (AuthenticationMode=0, no login form in any of the 4 forms).
The PII dataset is exposed in public source control alongside a live SQL-injection path capable of exfiltrating it (see escalation-record.json ESC-1).

per_module.rationale: 3 code smells (shared-mutable-global-state, resource-leak-no-disposal, hardcoded-configuration) concentrated in 13 lines; this module is the application's sole coupling point and its defects propagate to all 4 UI modules.
4 code smells including the application's only confirmed SQL-injection (ViewForm.vb:50), an event-handler leak, and triplicated load-data logic across LoadData/LoadSData/RefreshData.

God-class/god-form Designer file (1,211 LOC, 77 controls), a 72-line unbranched long-method (LoadData), a hardcoded temporal constant that has produced wrong dashboard output since 1 Jan 2024, and 5 unparameterized (if not currently exploitable) SQL statements.

Zero input validation anywhere on the create path, 3 unguarded ComboBox.SelectedItem dereferences, a broad catch-all exception handler that surfaces raw provider text to end users, and the default-instance aliasing defect that leaves sibling forms stale after a successful insert.

Duplicates InsertForm's field-mapping logic, performs no uniqueness check on the de-facto rollno key, parses dates culture-independently on read but culture-dependently on write, and carries the same broad exception-handling pattern.
Entirely Designer/IDE-generated plumbing (startup wiring, assembly metadata, settings accessor shell); no hand-written logic beyond AssemblyInfo attributes, no SQL, no PII access.

contributing_factors.smell_density: 21 distinct code-smell findings recorded across 461 hand-written LOC (~45 per KLOC) → subscore 85/100, weight 40%.
contributing_factors.coverage_gap: No test project, test file, or coverage tool output exists anywhere in the repository (method=unavailable, see test_coverage below); treated as the maximal gap (100/100) for THIS debt-scoring formula only — this is a deliberate scoring-time assumption, not a restatement of test_coverage.line_pct, which correctly stays null/omitted per the measurement-unavailable rule. Weight 30%.
contributing_factors.vuln_count: 1 confirmed exploitable SQL-injection (ViewForm.vb:50) plus 5 non-exploitable string-concatenated SQL statements (Form1.vb:62,67,72,77,82); no CVE/SCA database was available or applicable because the project has zero package-manager dependencies (all 10 references are GAC assembly references, no NuGet/packages.config) → subscore 50/100, weight 20%.
contributing_factors.churn_rate: Git history contains exactly 1 commit (structural-analysis.json summary_metrics.git_commits_in_history=1); no churn rate is computable from a single commit, so this input is floored at 0/100 with low confidence rather than estimated. Weight 10%.

measurement.notes: Smell inventory and per-module rationale were produced by a direct, full-file read of all 5 hand-written .vb files plus Module1.vb (461 LOC total) performed in this pass, cross-checked against Pass 1's independently-derived coupling_indicators/coupling_signals (same file:line evidence, corroborating rather than copied). No linter or static-analysis tool was invoked — hence 'repository-scan' rather than 'tool-run' — so the subscores above are a reproducible manual count, not a tool score. churn_rate carries low confidence because a single-commit history cannot support a real rate estimate.

measurement.reason: No test project, test file, test runner configuration, or CI/CD pipeline exists anywhere in the repository. Direct listing of the 'Flat Design' tree found 13 .vb source files and no corresponding test assembly; this is corroborated by Pass 1's 'no-automated-verification' coupling indicator (structural-analysis.json), which independently confirms zero test projects and zero CI pipelines. There is no coverage report, no instrumented build, and no tool to invoke, so no line/branch/overall percentage can be stated. Per the skill's own constraint, this absence of tooling is reported as 'unavailable', not as a 0% measurement.

escalation_triggers.threshold: Regulatory surface area: any module touching PII, financial calculations, or safety-critical paths — unconditional, applies regardless of metric scores.
escalation_triggers.note: All five modules read, write, or aggregate the PII-bearing 'students' table (names, father's name, two mobile numbers, date of birth). Combined with zero authentication and a confirmed SQL-injection path, this was escalated per profiles/faa quality-risk-assessor methodology as ESC-1 regardless of this application's low cyclomatic complexity and low afferent coupling.
